== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used (all Internet Archive captures of swccgpc.com, opened and checked):
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080803140549/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=90 (Worldwide SWCCG Day 2008, 13 July 2008)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080803131921/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=92 (V-16 Spoiler 1, 26 July 2008)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211140/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=94 (Policy of virtualizing, 15 August 2008)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211146/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=95 (Rules Info For Virtual Set 16, 15 August 2008)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153919/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=96 (Errata: Ultimatum-v/Resistance-v, 15 August 2008)
* https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211151/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=97 (Plo Koon v's new text, 18 August 2008)
=== Missing data ===
* Release date: the swccgpc.com captures read for this edit do not give it. The 15 August 2008 rules post opens "While waiting for V-16", so the set was not out that day; the infobox Released cell stays blank.
* The policy post says one card from the Top 35 list was virtualized in this set but does not name it.
=== Build notes ===
* The policy post names the Decipher cards used as templates (I've Decided To Go Back, Stay Here Where It's Safe, Emperor's Power) but not the resulting V16 card titles, so the text links the Decipher cards only.
* Card-level details (Plo Koon (V) revised text, the Luke's Ultimatum rename, the official rulings in sid=95) belong on the card articles and are left for the card-page pass.
